theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ₁ μ₂ μ₃ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Euclid P → MultiVector P k), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ₁ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ₂ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ₃ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ₁ μ₁ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ₂ μ₂ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ₃ μ₃ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ₁, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ₁ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ₂, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ₂ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ₃, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ₃ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, ∫ x, ξ₁ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₁ = ∫ x, ξ₂ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₂ + ∫ x, ξ₃ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₃) → ∀ (B : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : TestFormOn U k), MeasurableSet B → ∫ x in B, ξ₁ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₁ = ∫ x in B, ξ₂ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₂ + ∫ x in B, ξ₃ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₃
